candidates.explanation: After the password is changed through the reset link, the method only updates the user. It never deletes the user's existing sessions. The refresh tokens of already signed-in devices stay valid, so a phone can still call refresh and renew its login. The password-change path in AuthService.update (around line 469) does invalidate sessions, but resetPassword doesn't.

fix.description: After updating the password in resetPassword, call this.sessionService.deleteByUserId({ userId: user.id }) so every session for the user is removed and all refresh tokens stop working.
